description: Which header names carry a credential. The gateway's request log and trace export (agentcc-gateway/internal/credentials: credentials_test.go; the logging and otel plugins' tests) and the backend's request-log ingestion, request-log detail and stored-row scrub (futureagi/agentcc/services/credential_headers.py: futureagi/agentcc/tests/test_request_log_credential_headers.py) never keep the value of a header named under credential, and keep every header named under plain exactly as sent. Both tests read this file, so the two cannot drift apart unnoticed. Names match without regard to case, and an underscore counts as a hyphen. The first group under credential is the named list (every header the gateway reads its key from, every header a provider or guardrail adapter sends a key in, and common credential headers); the rest are caught by the name rule: a credential word anywhere (authorization, authorisation, authenticat, bearer, secret, password, passwd, passphrase, credential, cookie, signature, api-key, apikey, private-key, access-key, auth-key, subscription-key), the x-portkey- prefix, or the name's last part (after its last hyphen, underscore or dot): one that ends in token (but not tokens, tokenizer, or a token word followed by another part such as token-count or token_budget), one that is key after another part (but not a bare key, nor cache-key, x-cache-key, x-agentcc-cache-key, idempotency-key, x-idempotency-key), or one that ends in auth after another part.
